definition.def: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.
examples: Marx produced a new theory about historical change based upon conflict.
Einstein formulated the Theory of Relativity in 1905. [+ of]

definition.def: If you have a theory about something, you have your own opinion about it which you cannot prove but which you think is true.
examples: There was a theory that he wanted to marry her.
My theory is that you don't need a gym if you have stairs.

definition.def: The theory of a practical subject or skill is the set of rules and principles that form the basis of it.
examples: ...graduates who are well-trained in both the theory and practice of statistics.

definition.def: You use in theory to say that although something is supposed to be true or to happen in the way stated, it may not in fact be true or happen in that way.
examples: A school dental service exists in theory, but in practice, there are few dentists to work in it.
